# English typography

Typography balances each paragraph instead of filling one line at a time. Internationalization, characterization and pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism exercise hyphenation; office, affinity and efficient exercise ligatures.

“Opening quotes,” closing punctuation, (parentheses), [brackets], apostrophes in reader’s text, em—dashes and en–dashes remain attached to their neighbours. Café and Café, naïve, coöperate, Ångström, Agyp test accents and descenders.

Non-breaking spaces keep 10 kg and A B together. A soft hyphen in inter­nationalization supplies an optional break.

Words beside `a_long_identifier_with_123_and_more_characters` retain their ordinary break rules. A comma after `identifier`, stays with the code run.

Mixed text 中文API文字 and API中文text share lines with $\frac{a+b}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}$ and X<sup>2</sup>. Emoji 😀❤️⚠️ remain colored in **strong 😀**.
